subject: DI03005041

body.en:
Definition

Coal is a combustible, carbon-rich sedimentary material formed by the geological transformation of plant matter. It contains organic matter, mineral matter and moisture; it is not pure carbon.

Physical and fuel properties

Rank influences colour, hardness, lustre and volatile content. Moisture lowers useful heat per kilogram and adds drying duty. Ash is the noncombustible residue; high ash increases handling, slagging and disposal burdens. Volatile matter affects ignition and gas release. Fixed carbon is the proximate-analysis remainder after moisture, volatile matter and ash on the same basis; it is not identical to elemental carbon. Caking/coking behaviour determines whether a coherent coke can form.

Analysis and calorific value

Proximate analysis reports moisture, volatile matter, ash and fixed carbon; ultimate analysis reports elemental C, H, N, S and O, with the stated basis. Gross calorific value includes condensation of combustion water; net calorific value excludes that recovered latent heat. Sulphur, nitrogen, ash-fusion behaviour and grindability influence equipment choice and pollution control. Always distinguish as-received, dry and dry-ash-free values.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Plant matterના geological transformationથી બનેલો combustible, carbon-rich sedimentary material એટલે coal. તેમાં organic matter, mineral matter તથા moisture હોય છે; તે pure carbon નથી.

ભૌતિક તથા Fuel ગુણધર્મો

Rank પ્રમાણે colour, hardness, lustre તથા volatile content બદલાય છે. Moistureથી પ્રતિkg useful heat ઘટે છે અને drying duty વધે છે. Ash noncombustible residue છે; વધારે ashથી handling, slagging તથા disposal વધી જાય છે. Volatile matter ignition તથા gas releaseને અસર કરે છે. સમાન basis પર moisture, volatile matter તથા ash બાદનો proximate remainder fixed carbon છે; તે elemental carbon જેટલું નથી. Caking/coking behaviourથી coherent coke બની શકે કે નહીં તે નક્કી થાય છે.

Analysis તથા Calorific value

Proximate analysisમાં moisture, volatile matter, ash તથા fixed carbon મળે છે; ultimate analysisમાં stated basis પર elemental C, H, N, S તથા O મળે છે. Gross calorific valueમાં combustion water condensationની heat સામેલ છે; net valueમાં તે latent heat મળતી નથી. Sulphur, nitrogen, ash-fusion તથા grindability equipment અને pollution controlને અસર કરે છે. As-received, dry તથા dry-ash-free values જુદી રાખવી.

body.en:
Rank classification

The broad coalification sequence is peat precursor → lignite → bituminous coal → anthracite, with sub-bituminous coal between lignite and bituminous. Peat is a precursor rather than fully developed coal in strict classification. Rank generally rises with coalification and carbon enrichment; moisture and volatile tendencies generally fall, but actual heating value also depends on ash and moisture.

Properties and uses by type

Lignite is brown, moist and relatively low-rank:often mine-mouth power generation. Bituminous coal has a wide range of volatile/caking behaviour:power, industrial fuel and selected metallurgical-coke blends. Anthracite is hard, high-rank and low in volatile matter:smokeless heating and selected industrial uses; it is not automatically a good coking coal. Coking/non-coking is a behaviour-based division, not another rank sequence.
body.gu:
Rank મુજબ વર્ગીકરણ

Broad coalification ક્રમ peat precursor → lignite → bituminous → anthracite છે; sub-bituminous, lignite તથા bituminous વચ્ચે આવે છે. Strict classificationમાં peat precursor છે,પૂર્ણ વિકસિત coal નહીં. Coalification તથા carbon enrichment સાથે rank વધે છે; moisture/volatile tendencies સામાન્ય રીતે ઘટે છે,પરંતુ actual heating value ash તથા moisture પર પણ આધારિત છે.

પ્રકાર પ્રમાણે ગુણધર્મો તથા ઉપયોગો

Lignite brown, moist તથા low-rank છે: ઘણી વાર mine-mouth powerમાં વપરાય છે. Bituminous coalમાં volatile/caking behaviourની વિશાળ range છે: power, industrial fuel તથા પસંદ કરેલા metallurgical-coke blends માટે. Anthracite hard, high-rank તથા low-volatile છે: smokeless heating/selected industrial usesમાં વપરાય છે; તે આપમેળે સારું coking coal નથી. Coking/non-coking વર્તન આધારિત division છે,અલગ rank sequence નહીં.

body.en:
Classification of products

Coking gives solid coke, condensable coal tar, aqueous ammoniacal liquor and coke-oven gas. Tar fractionation gives light aromatic oil, phenolic oil, naphthalene-rich and anthracene-rich cuts, creosote oils and pitch. Light-oil recovery from coke-oven gas gives crude benzole, which is further refined to aromatics. Gasification gives CO/H2-containing gas; hydrogenation gives liquid hydrocarbons.

Uses and route distinction

Coke is a metallurgical fuel/reductant; tar aromatics feed dyes, resins and other synthesis; pitch is used in suitable binders/electrodes. Coking uses heat without air in the coal charge; gasification deliberately uses limited oxidant/steam; direct hydrogenation uses pressurised hydrogen. These routes have different products and cannot share an unchanged flowsheet.
body.gu:
Productsનું વર્ગીકરણ

Cokingથી solid coke, condensable coal tar, aqueous ammoniacal liquor તથા coke-oven gas મળે છે. Tar fractionationથી light aromatic oil, phenolic oil, naphthalene/anthracene-rich cuts, creosote oils તથા pitch મળે છે. Coke-oven gasમાંથી light-oil recoveryથી crude benzole મળે છે,જે આગળ aromatics માટે refine થાય છે. Gasificationથી CO/H2-containing gas તથા hydrogenationથી liquid hydrocarbons મળે છે.

ઉપયોગો તથા Routesનો ભેદ

Coke metallurgical fuel/reductant છે; tar aromatics dyes, resins તથા synthesisમાં જાય છે; pitch યોગ્ય binders/electrodesમાં વપરાય છે. Cokingમાં coal chargeની અંદર air વગર heat મળે છે; gasificationમાં limited oxidant/steam તથા direct hydrogenationમાં pressurised hydrogen વપરાય છે. Products જુદાં હોવાથી ત્રણેયની flowsheet એકસરખી નથી.

body.en:
Definition

Coking is the destructive distillation/carbonisation of suitable coal in the absence of air to produce coherent coke and recoverable volatile products.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Coking-coal blend and external heating fuel; the coke-oven charge is not mixed with combustion air.

Coal → coke + tar + gas + aqueous liquor (complex decomposition, not one balanced molecular equation).

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Coal preparation and oven construction—E01–E02

Coal types are blended, crushed and charged into narrow refractory chambers in an oven battery. Adjacent heating flues burn fuel outside the charge chamber; heat passes through the refractory walls. Suitable coal softens, becomes plastic, releases volatiles and resolidifies as a porous coke mass. High-temperature metallurgical coking is commonly around1000–1100°C; actual time and thermal profile depend on oven and blend.

2. Coke discharge and finishing—E03–E05

At the end of carbonisation, the hot coke is pushed into the approved quenching/cooling system. Wet quenching uses controlled water and produces steam; dry quenching uses an enclosed inert-gas heat-recovery circuit. Cooled coke is screened into specified sizes and stored. Cooling prevents uncontrolled burning and permits handling; it does not create the coke chemistry already formed in the oven.

3. By-product gas treatment—E06–E10

Volatile gas from the oven is cooled so tar and aqueous liquor condense and separate. Gas then passes through ammonia recovery and light-oil recovery; benzene/toluene-rich crude benzole is collected for refining. After suitable cleanup, the coke-oven gas goes to a gas holder; part can fuel the external oven-heating flues and surplus goes to approved users. Acid gases and residual contaminants require the plant-specific cleanup not expanded in this study sketch.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control coal blend, oven pressure, wall temperature, coke strength and gas capture. Prevent air ingress, fugitive benzene/PAH emissions, CO exposure and unsafe hot-coke handling. Tar/liquor streams need controlled treatment.

Applications / uses

Metallurgical coke for blast furnaces/foundries; tar aromatics, ammonia, light oils and recovered fuel gas as co-products.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Suitable coalને airની ગેરહાજરીમાં destructive distillation/carbonisation કરીને coherent coke તથા recoverable volatile products બનાવવું એટલે coking.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Coking-coal blend તથા external heating fuel લેવાય છે; ovenના coal chargeમાં combustion air ભેળવાતી નથી.

Coal → coke + tar + gas + aqueous liquor (complex decomposition, not one balanced molecular equation).

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Coal preparation તથા Oven construction—E01–E02

Coal types blend/crush કરીને oven batteryની સાંકડી refractory chambersમાં charge થાય છે. બાજુનાં heating fluesમાં fuel, charge chamberની બહાર બળે છે; heat refractory wallsમાંથી જાય છે. Suitable coal soften/plastic થાય છે,volatiles છોડે છે અને porous coke mass તરીકે ફરી solid બને છે. High-temperature metallurgical coking સામાન્ય રીતે આશરે1000–1100°Cએ થાય છે; actual time/thermal profile oven તથા blend પર આધારિત છે.

2. Coke discharge તથા Finishing—E03–E05

Carbonisation પછી hot coke approved quenching/cooling systemમાં push થાય છે. Wet quenchingમાં controlled waterથી steam બને છે; dry quenching enclosed inert-gas heat-recovery circuit વાપરે છે. Cooled coke specified sizesમાં screen થઈ store થાય છે. Cooling uncontrolled burning અટકાવે છે તથા handling શક્ય બનાવે છે; cokeની chemistry તો ovenમાં પહેલાં જ બની હોય છે.

3. By-product gas treatment—E06–E10

Ovenની volatile gas cool થતાં tar તથા aqueous liquor condense/separate થાય છે. Gas પછી ammonia recovery તથા light-oil recoveryમાંથી જાય છે; benzene/toluene-rich crude benzole refining માટે મળે છે. યોગ્ય cleanup પછી coke-oven gas gas holderમાં જાય છે; તેનો ભાગ ovenના external heating fluesમાં તથા surplus approved usersને જાય છે. Acid gases/residual contaminants માટે plant-specific cleanup જોઈએ,જે study sketchમાં વિસ્તૃત બતાવ્યું નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Coal blend, oven pressure, wall temperature, coke strength તથા gas capture નિયંત્રિત કરવા. Air ingress, fugitive benzene/PAH emissions, CO exposure તથા unsafe hot-coke handling અટકાવવાં. Tar/liquor streamsનું controlled treatment કરવું.

ઉપયોગો

Blast furnaces/foundries માટે metallurgical coke તથા co-products તરીકે tar aromatics, ammonia, light oils અને recovered fuel gas.

body.en:
Definition

Coal-tar distillation separates the complex tar mixture into useful boiling-range fractions and a heavy pitch residue.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Crude tar from coke-oven recovery. Tar composition and cut limits vary with the coal and carbonisation history.

Physical fractionation; no single chemical reaction is required.

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Settling, dehydration and heating—E01–E02

Crude tar is settled and dehydrated to remove water and suspended matter before strong heating. Water left in hot tar can cause violent foaming and unstable operation. The prepared tar is progressively heated in a still/heater and delivered to the fractionation system. Heat input must avoid excessive cracking or coke formation on heating surfaces.

2. Fractionation and pitch—E03

Vapours are separated by boiling range using condensation/reflux and suitable column/still arrangements. Broad teaching cuts are light oil below roughly170°C, phenolic/carbolic oil around170–230°C, middle/heavy oils over overlapping higher ranges, and anthracene-rich heavy oil at the upper distillation range. These are approximate historical cut descriptions, not universal product specifications. Non-distilled heavy material remains as pitch; the drawing’s outlets represent separate fractions, not a single mixed sale product.

3. Crystallisation and finishing—E04–E05

Naphthalene-rich oil is cooled to crystallise naphthalene, then crystals are separated and further purified as required. Anthracene-rich oil similarly gives a crude anthracene fraction by product-dependent cooling/separation. Phenols and light aromatics require their own refining to obtain specified chemicals. Distillation alone does not turn each complex cut into a pure compound.

Operating and engineering considerations

Manage water before heating, hot viscous pitch, fouling, vapour containment and toxic polycyclic-aromatic exposure. Product cut temperatures must be specified for the actual tar and pressure.

Applications / uses

Naphthalene and anthracene intermediates, dye/resin feedstocks, phenolic chemicals, approved creosote uses and pitch binders/electrodes.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Complex coal-tar mixtureને useful boiling-range fractions તથા heavy pitch residueમાં અલગ કરવું એટલે coal-tar distillation.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Coke-oven recoveryનું crude tar લેવાય છે. Coal તથા carbonisation history પ્રમાણે tar composition અને cut limits બદલાય છે.

Physical fractionation; no single chemical reaction is required.

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Settling, dehydration તથા Heating—E01–E02

Crude tarને settle/dehydrate કરીને water તથા suspended matter દૂર કરાય છે. Hot tarમાં બાકી waterથી તીવ્ર foaming તથા unstable operation થઈ શકે છે. Prepared tarને still/heaterમાં ક્રમશઃ ગરમ કરીને fractionation systemમાં મોકલાય છે. Excess cracking અથવા heating surfaces પર coke formation ન થાય તેમ heat આપવી.

2. Fractionation તથા Pitch—E03

Vapoursને condensation/reflux તથા યોગ્ય column/stillથી boiling range પ્રમાણે અલગ કરાય છે. Broad teaching cutsમાં light oil લગભગ170°Cથી નીચે,phenolic/carbolic oil આશરે170–230°C, overlapping higher rangesમાં middle/heavy oils તથા upper rangeમાં anthracene-rich heavy oil આવે છે. આ approximate historical ranges છે,universal specifications નહીં. Non-distilled heavy material pitch રહે છે; drawingનાં outlets જુદાં fractions છે,એક mixed sale product નહીં.

3. Crystallisation તથા Finishing—E04–E05

Naphthalene-rich oilને cool કરતાં naphthalene crystallise થાય છે; crystalsને અલગ કરીને જરૂર મુજબ purify કરાય છે. Anthracene-rich oilમાંથી product-dependent cooling/separationથી crude anthracene fraction મળે છે. Phenols તથા light aromaticsને specified chemicals માટે અલગ refining જોઈએ. માત્ર distillationથી દરેક complex cut pure compound બની જતું નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Heating પહેલાં water, hot viscous pitch, fouling, vapour containment તથા toxic polycyclic-aromatic exposure નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. Actual tar/pressure પ્રમાણે cut temperatures નક્કી કરવાં.

ઉપયોગો

Naphthalene/anthracene intermediates, dye/resin feedstocks, phenolic chemicals, approved creosote uses તથા pitch binders/electrodes.

notes.reaction_summary: Physical fractionation;no single chemical reaction is required.

body.en:
Definition

Coal gasification converts coal into a combustible/synthesis gas by controlled partial oxidation and reactions with steam rather than complete combustion.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Sized coal, oxygen and steam. The selected drawing is a pressurised fixed-bed route; air-blown, fluidised-bed and entrained-flow gasifiers differ.

C + O2 → CO2; C + CO2 ⇌ 2CO; C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2; CO + H2O ⇌ CO2 + H2 (water-gas shift).

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Feed entry and gasifier zones—E01–E03

Prepared coal enters through pressure lock hoppers, which admit solids without continuously venting gasifier pressure. Coal descends through drying, devolatilisation, reduction/gasification and oxidation regions while gases rise countercurrently in the selected fixed-bed arrangement. Oxygen burns a portion of carbon to provide heat; steam and CO2 react with hot carbon to form CO and H2. Thus both exothermic and endothermic reactions occur in different regions.

2. Ash and raw-gas cleanup—E03–E05

Mineral matter leaves by the gasifier’s controlled ash/slag system; the actual outlet form depends on design. Hot raw gas contains steam, dust, tar and acid-gas contaminants as well as useful CO/H2. The quench/scrubber removes heat and entrained solids and condenses tar/water. The separator withdraws contaminated liquid for treatment instead of sending it directly into the clean-gas line.

3. Acid-gas removal and product adjustment—E06–E07

Acid-gas treatment removes contaminants such as H2S and, when required, CO2 before gas distribution. The CO/H2 ratio can be adjusted by a separate shift-conversion step when a synthesis application requires it; that optional reactor is not shown in this diagram. Cleaned gas is then used as fuel or as feedstock after the additional purity/ratio conditioning required by its downstream process.

Operating and engineering considerations

Control steam/oxygen ratio, temperature, pressure, ash behaviour, tar removal and gas sealing. CO is acutely toxic; H2S, pressure and oxygen service require specialised protection. Oxygen-blown and air-blown product compositions must not be interchanged.

Applications / uses

Fuel gas; hydrogen, ammonia, methanol and synthetic-fuel feed after suitable shift/separation and purification.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

Complete combustionને બદલે controlled partial oxidation તથા steam reactionsથી coalને combustible/synthesis gasમાં ફેરવવું એટલે gasification.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Sized coal, oxygen તથા steam લેવાય છે. પસંદ કરેલી drawing pressurised fixed-bed route છે; air-blown, fluidised-bed તથા entrained-flow routes જુદી છે.

C + O2 → CO2; C + CO2 ⇌ 2CO; C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2; CO + H2O ⇌ CO2 + H2 (water-gas shift).

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Feed entry તથા Gasifier zones—E01–E03

Prepared coal pressure lock hoppersથી જાય છે,જેથી સતત pressure vent કર્યા વગર solids દાખલ થઈ શકે. Selected fixed bedમાં coal drying, devolatilisation, reduction/gasification તથા oxidation regionsમાંથી નીચે આવે છે અને gases countercurrent ઉપર જાય છે. Oxygen carbonના ભાગને burn કરીને heat આપે છે; steam તથા CO2 hot carbon સાથે react કરીને CO/H2 બનાવે છે. એટલે જુદા regionsમાં exothermic તથા endothermic reactions બંને થાય છે.

2. Ash તથા Raw-gas cleanup—E03–E05

Mineral matter controlled ash/slag systemથી બહાર આવે છે; outlet form design પ્રમાણે હોય છે. Raw gasમાં useful CO/H2 ઉપરાંત steam, dust, tar તથા acid-gas contaminants હોય છે. Quench/scrubber heat/entrained solids દૂર કરીને tar/water condense કરે છે. Separator contaminated liquidને treatmentમાં મોકલે છે,clean-gas lineમાં નહીં.

3. Acid-gas removal તથા Product adjustment—E06–E07

Acid-gas treatment H2S તથા જરૂર મુજબ CO2 દૂર કરે છે. Synthesis માટે CO/H2 ratio બદલવો હોય તો separate shift-conversion step ઉમેરાય છે; તે optional reactor આ diagramમાં નથી. Cleaned gas fuel તરીકે અથવા downstream purity/ratio conditioning પછી feedstock તરીકે વપરાય છે.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

Steam/oxygen ratio, temperature, pressure, ash behaviour, tar removal તથા gas sealing નિયંત્રિત કરવાં. CO અત્યંત toxic છે; H2S, pressure તથા oxygen service માટે specialised protection જોઈએ. Oxygen-blown તથા air-blown gas compositions એકસરખાં માનવાં નહીં.

ઉપયોગો

Fuel gas તથા યોગ્ય shift/separation/purification પછી hydrogen, ammonia, methanol અને synthetic-fuel feed માટે ઉપયોગ.

notes.reaction_summary: C + O2 → CO2; C + CO2 ⇌ 2CO; C + H2O ⇌ CO + H2; CO + H2O ⇌ CO2 + H2 (water-gas shift).

body.en:
Definition

Direct coal hydrogenation converts coal organic matter into liquid hydrocarbons by reaction with hydrogen at high temperature and pressure; the representative route is Bergius-type liquefaction.

Raw materials and reaction principle

Dried finely ground coal, heavy carrier/recycle oil, hydrogen and a suitable catalyst system.

Coal organic structures + H2 → liquid hydrocarbons + gases + heteroatom-removal products (complex network, not one fixed coal formula).

Labelled syllabus flowsheet

1. Paste preparation and pressurising—E01–E03

Coal is dried and pulverised, then mixed with heavy oil and catalyst to form a pumpable paste. The paste is pressurised and preheated with fresh/recycled hydrogen. Oil carries the coal through the system and assists heat/mass transfer; it is partly recovered from the downstream fractionator. Coal cannot be treated as a simple gas feed to an ordinary low-pressure hydrogenation vessel.

2. High-pressure liquefaction—E04

In the hydrogenation reactor, thermal cleavage breaks large coal structures and hydrogen stabilises reactive fragments to favour liquids over char. Catalysts assist hydrogen transfer and removal of some sulphur, oxygen and nitrogen into gaseous products. Classic descriptions use roughly400–500°C and pressures of order tens of MPa; these are broad route characteristics, not operating instructions or a universal safe setpoint.

3. Separation, fractionation and recycle—E05–E09

Hot separation removes solids-rich residue and hydrogen-rich gas; cooling/condensation recovers liquid. Gas cleanup and compression return usable hydrogen, with a purge to prevent inert/light-gas accumulation. Fractionation separates light/middle products from heavy recycle oil, which returns to paste preparation. Finished fuels require further treatment to meet specification; the reactor liquid is not automatically finished petrol.

Operating and engineering considerations

High hydrogen demand, high-pressure containment, abrasive slurry erosion, catalyst/residue handling and product upgrading govern feasibility. This is direct liquefaction; Fischer–Tropsch synthesis after gasification is a different, indirect route.

Applications / uses

Liquid-fuel and chemical-feedstock production from coal where the technology is selected.
body.gu:
વ્યાખ્યા

High temperature/pressure પર hydrogen સાથે coal organic matterને react કરીને liquid hydrocarbons બનાવવું એટલે direct coal hydrogenation; representative route Bergius-type liquefaction છે.

કાચો માલ તથા અભિક્રિયાનો સિદ્ધાંત

Dried finely ground coal, heavy carrier/recycle oil, hydrogen તથા suitable catalyst system લેવાય છે.

Coal organic structures + H2 → liquid hydrocarbons + gases + heteroatom-removal products (complex network, not one fixed coal formula).

Syllabus મુજબ labelled flowsheet

1. Paste preparation તથા Pressurising—E01–E03

Coal dry/pulverise થયા પછી heavy oil તથા catalyst સાથે pumpable paste બને છે. Pasteને fresh/recycled hydrogen સાથે pressurise/preheat કરાય છે. Oil coalને systemમાં વહન કરે છે અને heat/mass transferમાં મદદ કરે છે; તેનો ભાગ downstream fractionatorથી પાછો મળે છે. Coalને ordinary low-pressure hydrogenation vesselમાં simple gas feed સમાન ગણવો નહીં.

2. High-pressure liquefaction—E04

Hydrogenation reactorમાં thermal cleavageથી મોટા coal structures તૂટે છે; hydrogen reactive fragmentsને stabilise કરીને char કરતાં liquid formation તરફ દોરી જાય છે. Catalysts hydrogen transfer તથા કેટલાક S/O/N removalમાં મદદ કરે છે. Classic routeમાં આશરે400–500°C અને tens of MPa orderના pressures વર્ણવાય છે; આ broad characteristics છે,operating instructions અથવા universal safe setpoint નહીં.

3. Separation, fractionation તથા Recycle—E05–E09

Hot separationમાં solids-rich residue તથા hydrogen-rich gas અલગ થાય છે; cooling/condensationથી liquid મળે છે. Gas cleanup/compression usable hydrogen પાછું મોકલે છે; inert/light gasesના accumulationને રોકવા purge રાખાય છે. Fractionation light/middle productsને heavy recycle oilથી અલગ કરે છે; heavy oil paste preparationમાં પાછું જાય છે. Specification માટે further treatment પછી fuel મળે છે; reactor liquid સીધું finished petrol નથી.

પ્રક્રિયા નિયંત્રણ તથા Engineering બાબતો

High hydrogen demand, high-pressure containment, abrasive slurry erosion, catalyst/residue handling તથા product upgrading feasibility નક્કી કરે છે. આ direct liquefaction છે; gasification પછી Fischer–Tropsch synthesis જુદી indirect route છે.

ઉપયોગો

Technology પસંદ કરવામાં આવે ત્યાં coalમાંથી liquid fuels તથા chemical feedstocks બનાવવા ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
Aim

Find moisture content in coal

Principle

Loss of mass under the prescribed coal-moisture drying method represents moisture on the stated basis; overheating can also lose volatile matter and invalidate the result.

Apparatus and approved materials

Representative coal sample, balance, covered moisture dish, controlled oven and desiccator under the laboratory’s assigned standard.

Supervised procedure / process record

Weigh dry empty dish, add representative sample and record initial mass. Dry under the prescribed method, often in the105–110°C region for a specified oven-moisture test; cool in a desiccator and reweigh. Repeat to the method’s mass-stability criterion without substituting an arbitrary high temperature. State whether the sample basis is as-received or air-dried.

Observations to record—leave actual values blank until performed

m0empty dish:____g; m1dish+initial sample:____g; m2dish+dried sample:____g; drying standard/time/temperature:____;repeat mass:____g.

Calculation relation

Moisture(as tested)%=(m1−m2)/(m1−m0)×100. An air-dried residual-moisture result is not automatically total as-received moisture.

Precautions and evidence

Work only in the supervised institutional laboratory under the instructor-approved SOP and current SDS. Confirm ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container and emergency arrangements before starting. Do not taste/smell products or invent readings. Record date, SOP reference, actual observations and teacher verification; hazardous preparations below are study support, not standalone operating recipes.

Result / conclusion to complete

Measured result:____;specified units/grade:____;uncertainty or deviation:____;conclusion from actual evidence:____.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Coalનું Moisture Content શોધવું

સિદ્ધાંત

Prescribed coal-moisture drying methodનો mass loss stated basisનું moisture બતાવે છે; overheatingથી volatile matter પણ નીકળે તો result ખોટું પડે.

સાધનો તથા Approved materials

Representative coal sample, balance, covered dish, controlled oven તથા desiccator; laboratoryના assigned standard મુજબ.

Supervised procedure તથા Process record

Dry empty dish weigh કરીને representative sample તથા initial mass નોંધો. Prescribed method મુજબ dry કરો; specified oven-moisture testમાં ઘણી વાર105–110°C વિસ્તાર હોય છે. Desiccatorમાં cool કરીને reweigh કરો. Methodની mass-stability criterion સુધી repeat કરો; મનસ્વી high temperature નહીં. Sample as-received છે કે air-dried તે લખો.

નોંધવાની Observations—પ્રયોગ કર્યા વગર Values ભરવી નહીં

m0empty dish:____g; m1dish+initial sample:____g; m2dish+dried sample:____g; drying standard/time/temperature:____;repeat mass:____g.

ગણતરીનો સંબંધ

Moisture(as tested)%=(m1−m2)/(m1−m0)×100. An air-dried residual-moisture result is not automatically total as-received moisture.

સાવચેતીઓ તથા Evidence

Instructor-approved SOP તથા current SDS મુજબ supervised institutional labમાં જ કામ કરવું. શરૂઆત પહેલાં ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container તથા emergency arrangements ચકાસવાં. Products taste/smell ન કરવા અને readings બનાવવી નહીં. Date, SOP reference, actual observations તથા teacher verification નોંધવાં; નીચેના hazardous preparations study support છે,standalone operating recipes નહીં.

પૂર્ણ કરવાનો Result / Conclusion

માપેલું Result:____;specified units/grade:____;uncertainty/deviation:____;actual evidence પરથી Conclusion:____.

body.en:
Aim

Determine coal calorific value

Principle

A calibrated bomb calorimeter measures combustion heat. Corrected heat rise and specified fuse/acid/auxiliary corrections give gross calorific value on the stated sample basis.

Apparatus and approved materials

Certified pressure-rated bomb calorimeter, calibration certificate, approved ignition system, balance and temperature/data acquisition system. Only trained staff handle oxygen charging/pressure operations.

Supervised procedure / process record

Verify calibration/status and inspect the rated apparatus with the instructor. The trained operator prepares/charges the bomb under its manufacturer SOP; students record sample mass, temperature trace and supplied correction data. After the approved cooled/depressurised condition, record residue/combustion completeness and calculate GCV. No DIY pressure vessel, improvised charging or opening a pressurised bomb.

Observations to record—leave actual values blank until performed

Sample basis:____;m:____kg; calorimeter effective heat capacity Ccal:____J/K; corrected ΔT:____K; total specified non-sample heat correction:____J; replicates:____.

Calculation relation

GCV(J/kg)=[Ccal×ΔTcorrected−Σnon-sample heat corrections]/m. If Ccal already includes water, do not add the water heat capacity again. Divide J/kg by1000 for kJ/kg; NCV needs additional moisture/hydrogen data and an explicit convention.

Precautions and evidence

Work only in the supervised institutional laboratory under the instructor-approved SOP and current SDS. Confirm ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container and emergency arrangements before starting. Do not taste/smell products or invent readings. Record date, SOP reference, actual observations and teacher verification; hazardous preparations below are study support, not standalone operating recipes.

Result / conclusion to complete

Measured result:____;specified units/grade:____;uncertainty or deviation:____;conclusion from actual evidence:____.
body.gu:
હેતુ

Coalનું Calorific Value નક્કી કરવું

સિદ્ધાંત

Calibrated bomb calorimeter combustion heat માપે છે. Corrected temperature rise તથા specified fuse/acid/auxiliary correctionsથી stated basis પર gross calorific value મળે છે.

સાધનો તથા Approved materials

Certified pressure-rated bomb calorimeter, calibration certificate, approved ignition system, balance તથા temperature/data system. Oxygen charging/pressure operations ફક્ત trained staff કરે.

Supervised procedure તથા Process record

Instructor સાથે calibration/status તથા rated apparatus તપાસો. Trained operator manufacturer SOPથી bomb prepare/charge કરે; students sample mass, temperature trace તથા correction data નોંધે. Approved cooled/depressurised condition પછી residue/combustion completeness તપાસીને GCV ગણો. DIY vessel, improvised charging અથવા pressurised bomb ખોલવું નહીં.

નોંધવાની Observations—પ્રયોગ કર્યા વગર Values ભરવી નહીં

Sample basis:____;m:____kg; Ccal:____J/K; corrected ΔT:____K; specified non-sample correction:____J; replicates:____.

ગણતરીનો સંબંધ

GCV(J/kg)=[Ccal×ΔTcorrected−Σnon-sample heat corrections]/m. If Ccal already includes water, do not add the water heat capacity again. Divide J/kg by1000 for kJ/kg; NCV needs additional moisture/hydrogen data and an explicit convention.

સાવચેતીઓ તથા Evidence

Instructor-approved SOP તથા current SDS મુજબ supervised institutional labમાં જ કામ કરવું. શરૂઆત પહેલાં ventilation, PPE, compatible equipment, waste container તથા emergency arrangements ચકાસવાં. Products taste/smell ન કરવા અને readings બનાવવી નહીં. Date, SOP reference, actual observations તથા teacher verification નોંધવાં; નીચેના hazardous preparations study support છે,standalone operating recipes નહીં.

body.en:
Illustrative calculation with stated hypothetical data; not an actual practical result.

Given

All values on the same as-tested basis:moisture8%,volatile matter27%,ash15%.

Find and formula

Fixed carbon%=100−moisture%−volatile%−ash%.

Substitution and calculation

FC=100−8−27−15=50%.Dry-basis FC=50/(100−8)×100=54.3478%.

Final answer and check

Fixed carbon=50% as tested;54.35% on dry basis.8+27+15+50=100%.Do not subtract data reported on different bases.
body.gu:
આપેલી illustrative માહિતીથી ગણતરી; actual practical result નથી.

આપેલી માહિતી

બધા values સમાન as-tested basis પર:moisture8%,volatile matter27%,ash15%.

શોધવું તથા સૂત્ર

Fixed carbon%=100−moisture%−volatile%−ash%.

મૂલ્યો મૂકી ગણતરી

FC=100−8−27−15=50%.Dry-basis FC=50/(100−8)×100=54.3478%.

અંતિમ જવાબ તથા ચકાસણી

Fixed carbon=50% as tested; dry basis પર54.35%.8+27+15+50=100%. જુદા basesનાં data subtract ન કરવાં.

title.en: How to study a manufacturing answer

body.en: State the product and route,raw materials and reaction;draw the correctly labelled flowsheet;explain each stage in arrow order with recycle/by-products;finish with key controls and uses. Equipment in original supplied scans must be identified by their printed names;E-numbers refer only to new study redraws.
body.gu: Product/route,raw materials તથા reaction લખો;સાચી labelled flowsheet દોરો;arrow order મુજબ દરેક stage તથા recycle/by-products સમજાવો;છેલ્લે key controls/uses આપો. મૂળ scansના equipmentને તેમના printed namesથી ઓળખો;E numbers ફક્ત નવા study redraws માટે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Coal—definition and important properties.
q.gu: કોલસો—વ્યાખ્યા તથા મુખ્ય ગુણધર્મોની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Coal is a combustible, carbon-rich sedimentary material formed by the geological transformation of plant matter. It contains organic matter, mineral matter and moisture; it is not pure carbon.
a.gu: Plant matterના geological transformationથી બનેલો combustible, carbon-rich sedimentary material એટલે coal. તેમાં organic matter, mineral matter તથા moisture હોય છે; તે pure carbon નથી.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Types of coal.

a.en: The broad coalification sequence is peat precursor → lignite → bituminous coal → anthracite, with sub-bituminous coal between lignite and bituminous. Peat is a precursor rather than fully developed coal in strict classification. Rank generally rises with coalification and carbon enrichment; moisture and volatile tendencies generally fall, but actual heating value also depends on ash and moisture.
a.gu: Broad coalification ક્રમ peat precursor → lignite → bituminous → anthracite છે; sub-bituminous, lignite તથા bituminous વચ્ચે આવે છે. Strict classificationમાં peat precursor છે,પૂર્ણ વિકસિત coal નહીં. Coalification તથા carbon enrichment સાથે rank વધે છે; moisture/volatile tendencies સામાન્ય રીતે ઘટે છે,પરંતુ actual heating value ash તથા moisture પર પણ આધારિત છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Coal chemicals and conversion routes.
q.gu: Coal Chemicals તથા Conversion Routesની વ્યાખ્યા/સિદ્ધાંત જણાવો.

a.en: Coking gives solid coke, condensable coal tar, aqueous ammoniacal liquor and coke-oven gas. Tar fractionation gives light aromatic oil, phenolic oil, naphthalene-rich and anthracene-rich cuts, creosote oils and pitch. Light-oil recovery from coke-oven gas gives crude benzole, which is further refined to aromatics. Gasification gives CO/H2-containing gas; hydrogenation gives liquid hydrocarbons.
a.gu: Cokingથી solid coke, condensable coal tar, aqueous ammoniacal liquor તથા coke-oven gas મળે છે. Tar fractionationથી light aromatic oil, phenolic oil, naphthalene/anthracene-rich cuts, creosote oils તથા pitch મળે છે. Coke-oven gasમાંથી light-oil recoveryથી crude benzole મળે છે,જે આગળ aromatics માટે refine થાય છે. Gasificationથી CO/H2-containing gas તથા hydrogenationથી liquid hydrocarbons મળે છે.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Coking of coal.

a.en: Coking is the destructive distillation/carbonisation of suitable coal in the absence of air to produce coherent coke and recoverable volatile products.
a.gu: Suitable coalને airની ગેરહાજરીમાં destructive distillation/carbonisation કરીને coherent coke તથા recoverable volatile products બનાવવું એટલે coking.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Distillation of coal tar.

a.en: Coal-tar distillation separates the complex tar mixture into useful boiling-range fractions and a heavy pitch residue.
a.gu: Complex coal-tar mixtureને useful boiling-range fractions તથા heavy pitch residueમાં અલગ કરવું એટલે coal-tar distillation.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Gasification of coal.

a.en: Coal gasification converts coal into a combustible/synthesis gas by controlled partial oxidation and reactions with steam rather than complete combustion.
a.gu: Complete combustionને બદલે controlled partial oxidation તથા steam reactionsથી coalને combustible/synthesis gasમાં ફેરવવું એટલે gasification.

q.en: State the definition/principle of Hydrogenation of coal.

a.en: Direct coal hydrogenation converts coal organic matter into liquid hydrocarbons by reaction with hydrogen at high temperature and pressure; the representative route is Bergius-type liquefaction.
a.gu: High temperature/pressure પર hydrogen સાથે coal organic matterને react કરીને liquid hydrocarbons બનાવવું એટલે direct coal hydrogenation; representative route Bergius-type liquefaction છે.

q.en: Explain proximate and ultimate analyses of coal and the meaning of fixed carbon.
q.gu: Coalના proximate/ultimate analyses તથા fixed carbonનો અર્થ સમજાવો.

q.en: Classify coal by rank and distinguish coking from non-coking behaviour.
q.gu: Coalને rank પ્રમાણે classify કરો અને coking/non-coking behaviour જુદું સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain coking with coke finishing and by-product gas recovery using a flowsheet.
q.gu: Flowsheetથી coking,coke finishing તથા by-product gas recovery સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain coal-tar distillation and the recovery/uses of its principal fractions.
q.gu: Coal-tar distillation તથા મુખ્ય fractionsની recovery/uses સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain the selected coal-gasification flowsheet and key reactions.
q.gu: Selected coal-gasification flowsheet તથા key reactions સમજાવો.

q.en: Explain direct Bergius-type coal hydrogenation with hydrogen/heavy-oil recycle.
q.gu: Hydrogen/heavy-oil recycle સાથે direct Bergius-type coal hydrogenation સમજાવો.

q.en: Distinguish coking,gasification and direct hydrogenation by feed condition,principle and products.
q.gu: Feed condition,principle તથા products મુજબ coking,gasification અને direct hydrogenation જુદાં પાડો.
